description: Established in 1942, Lambert's Cafe is a renowned family-friendly restaurant in Sikeston, Missouri, serving delicious southern fare. Experience our unique tradition of throwing rolls to diners. We offer a full hook-up RV Park at our Sikeston and Ozark locations. raw_text_content: Lambert's Cafe - Home of Throwed Rolls. Established in 1942, Lambert's Cafe is a renowned family-friendly restaurant in Sikeston, Missouri, serving delicious southern fare. Experience our unique tradition of throwing rolls to diners. Popular dishes: Country Fried Round Steak - Really - the old fashioned beef round steak. Locations: Sikeston, MO - 2305 East Malone Ave, Sikeston, MO 63801, 573-471-4261, Lamberts1@Throwedrolls.com. Ozark, MO - 1800 W. State Highway J, Ozark, MO 65721, 417-581-7655, Lamberts2@Throwedrolls.com. Foley, AL - 2981 S. McKenzie Foley, AL 36535. RV Park - We offer a full hook-up RV Park at our Sikeston and Ozark locations, for when you need some food and a rest. TO-GO Orders - Call ahead and place your order. We will have it fresh and ready for ya. Merchandise - Huge selection of cups, apparel, hats and recently added jams, jellies, preserves, beef sticks, and ciders. Come sit a spell and enjoy some home cookin'. From meatloaf to grilled shrimp we are sure to have something to satisfy.
